text:
acme-sec: Hi, we need end-to-end evidence that the erasure request we submitted (ERASE-2025-08-01-ACME) was propagated to all sub-processors in the EU region and that the HSM-backed keys that encrypted the deleted blobs were rotated/decommissioned. customer legal is asking for a single PDF with timeline + logs.

support-julia: Thanks — we can help. Can you confirm the account ID and the exact object IDs/paths you want proof for?

acme-sec: Account ID: acme-123. Objects: /uploads/customer_exports/* from 2024-12-01 to 2025-08-01. We also need confirmation of KMS key id: redwood-eu-kg-77 and HSM attestation that key material was destroyed.

maria-security: looping in security. We have two threads here: 1) audit logs showing erase events propagated to sub-processors (who/when/response codes). 2) key lifecycle evidence from KMS/HSM (rotation, zeroization).

maria-security: Julia, for (1) we'll need to pull the audit index and sub-processor delivery receipts. Please include the DPA-subprocessor list snapshot for the date range.

support-julia: Copy. I'll pull receipts and the audit index. What format does the customer want the PDF in? Include hashes?

ops-legal: ops-legal: they asked for timeline + logs + attestation. We should avoid including raw PII in the PDF; instead include redacted entries and a separate checksum list for artifacts. Also add the DPA clause reference and contact info.

support-julia: Understood. I'll generate redacted logs + checksums. Maria, can you confirm if we have an HSM attestation report for redwood-eu-kg-77?

kms-hsm-bot: HSM report lookup: key.redwood-eu-kg-77 -> last rotation 2025-07-15, export_prohibited flag = true, destruction_event = 2025-08-02T03:12:18Z (initiated), attestation_id = att-20250802-8821. Binary attestation stored in secure-audit.blob (access-controlled).

maria-security: Good — I see the attestation id. We'll include signed attestation and a chain of custody note. Julia, can you query the audit logs for erasure events showing HTTP 200 to subproc endpoints and receipts? Use the internal audit query below.

support-julia: Running now. Snippet of query I used:
```
# internal audit query
SELECT ts, event, target, subprocessor, response_code, request_id
FROM audit_events
WHERE account_id = 'acme-123'
  AND event = 'erasure_propagation'
  AND ts BETWEEN '2025-08-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2025-08-03T00:00:00Z'
ORDER BY ts;
```

support-julia: Results: several hits. Example rows (redacted):
- 2025-08-01T02:14:05Z, erasure_propagation, /uploads/customer_exports/2024-12-05.zip, subproc:eu-storage-1, 200, req-85a3
- 2025-08-01T02:14:12Z, erasure_propagation, /uploads/customer_exports/2025-01-11.csv, subproc:eu-analytics-2, 202, req-85a4 (accepted, async)
- 2025-08-01T03:12:20Z, erasure_confirmed, /uploads/customer_exports/2024-12-05.zip, subproc:eu-storage-1, 200, req-85a3

acme-sec: Ok good. For async ones we need receipts showing final confirmation — do you have delivery receipts for eu-analytics-2?

support-julia: For async flows we have webhook receipts stored in delivery_receipts table. Query: 
```
SELECT subprocessor, receipt_ts, status, receipt_id
FROM delivery_receipts
WHERE request_id IN ('req-85a4')
```
Got: eu-analytics-2, 2025-08-02T10:21:33Z, deleted, rcpt-9921.

david-sre: FYI — we did a workflow sweep on 2025-08-02 to reconcile all pending erasure jobs in EU pool. Job id sweep-20250802 reconciled 471/471 records. I can export the reconciliation manifest if needed.

acme-sec: Please include the reconciliation manifest and the delivery_receipts export. Also can you confirm that any cached KV entries were purged and that prefix/KV caches were flushed? We saw some residual latency and want to be sure nothing remains.

david-sre: KV cache purge recorded at 2025-08-02T03:13:05Z for prefix /uploads/customer_exports/. Purge event id: purge-20250802-acme. I'll attach the purge log excerpt.

maria-security: Good. For the KMS/HSM side: we will compile the attestation (att-20250802-8821), the HSM audit chain (module serial sn-4433, operator id), and the KMS key record showing rotation -> destruction. ops-legal: confirm redaction rules for attestation (any operator names?).

ops-legal: redact personal operator identifiers; include operator role ids and signed device serials. Also include DPA sub-processor manifest as of 2025-08-01 and a statement of how Redwood routes erasure requests to sub-processors (sync vs async).

support-julia: Draft PDF will contain: timeline.csv (events with checksums), redacted_audit_logs.pdf, attestation_att-20250802-8821.pdf (signed), reconciliation_manifest.csv, delivery_receipts.csv, purge_log_excerpt.txt, and DPA_subproc_manifest_20250801.json (redacted).

acme-sec: Timeline must show who we can contact at each sub-processor if legal needs direct communication. If sub-processors refuse, we need a statement of Redwood remediation steps.

maria-security: We'll include contact pointers and a remediation escalation clause. Also note that for some sub-processors we only have confirmation of deletion (status deleted) not the internal retention scrub schedule — we'll flag those and include their published retention policy URLs.

support-julia: ETA to produce everything: end of day tomorrow (2025-08-04 EOD). If legal needs the signed attestation sooner we can provide that earlier.

acme-sec: EOD tomorrow works. One last ask — can you produce a single verification command we can run against the checksums to verify exported artifacts match the PDFs?

support-julia: Yes. Example verification (customer runs locally):
```
# verify artifact checksums
sha256sum timeline.csv redacted_audit_logs.pdf attestation_att-20250802-8821.pdf reconciliation_manifest.csv | sha256sum -c checksums.sha256
```
I'll include checksums.sha256 in the archive.

acme-sec: Perfect — thanks Julia and team.

maria-security: Noted. We'll redact PII and prepare attestation bundle. If anything changes I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

kms-hsm-bot: Access note: att-20250802-8821 notarized and stored in secure-audit.blob vault path: /vaults/eu/attestations/att-20250802-8821.bin (access: ops+security only).

support-julia: Closing loop — I'll upload the package to a secure share and post link here when ready.

acme-sec: Received, standing by for the package.
